content: अञ्जि {%a.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> [अञ्ज्-इन्] Unctuous, slimy; lubricated, shining, brilliant. .{@-ञ्जिः@} .²1 A mark made with sandal <ab>&c.</ab> a Tilaka mark; रोहिताञ्जिरनड्वान् <ls>Yaj.</ls> (रक्ततिलक). .²2 A commander, sender <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-ञ्जिः, -ञ्जी@} {%f.%} .²1 An ointment, pigment. .²2 Colour, hue. .²3 The sexual organ (?).
